params.text: Quasi-complementary output at +/-25 V: an NPN Darlington (VT5, VT7) on top and a feedback pair (VT6, VT8) below, both outputs TIP41C (D2PAK). 32 W into 8 ohm at 1 % THD.
Input pair VT1/VT2 with a PNP current mirror (VT11, VT12) and an LED-referenced tail sink (VT3). The VAS (VT4) works into a bootstrapped load (R9, R10, C5).
RP1 on the Vbe multiplier VT9 sets the quiescent current (about 40 mA); mount VT9 on the heatsink. Gain R5/R4 + 1 = 23 (27 dB).
